fullContentHtml:
MPPSC Assistant Professor Admit Card 2026 - Complete Details

Short Information : Madhya Pradesh Public Service Commission (MPPSC) has released the Admit Card for the post of Assistant Professor. This recruitment has been issued for 148 posts. Online applying process for MPPSC Assistant Professor Recruitment 2026 were accepted from 25 May 2026 to 26 June 2026. Candidates must download their for MPPSC Assistant Professor Admit Card 2026 which has given below.

Important Dates

  • Application Start Date : 25 May 2026
  • Last Date : 26 June 2026
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 26 June 2026
  • Correction Date : 30 May-28 June 2026
  • Exam Date : 02 August 2026
  • Admit Card : 29 July 2026

Application Fee

  • General, Other State : Rs. 500/-
  • SC, ST, OBC, EWS, PH : Rs. 250/-
  • Candidates have to pay their Examination Fee Through Debit Card / Credit Card / Net Banking / UPI and Other Fee Payment Mode Only.

How to Download Admit Card

  1. Visit the official website.
  2. Click on the admit card / hall ticket link.
  3. Enter your registration number / roll number and date of birth / password.
  4. Click on submit to view your admit card.
  5. Download and take a printout. Carry it to the exam center along with a photo ID.

Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

What is MPPSC Assistant Professor Admit Card 2026?

MPPSC Assistant Professor Admit Card 2026 is a government exam related notification. Complete details including important dates, fee, eligibility and links are provided above.

What is the last date to apply?

The last date to apply is 26 June 2026.

Where can I find the official website?

The official website is: https://mppsc.mp.gov.in/

How to download admit card?

Click on the relevant link in the Important Links section above or visit the official website directly.
